title: Linux and Intel macOS binaries are not built
body:
The release builds one arch. Linux and Intel macOS binaries are not built; size L. Surfaced at the 3.0.1 cut and not worked. Carried in `intent/wip.md` until 2026-09-13.


**RULED 2026-09-15 (hv, at the close-out; intent/history/20260915-hv-rulings.md, item 8): out of 3.x.** The release stays Apple Silicon macOS only, and this issue reopens on the first request for another platform.
